directive: 目的、場所、人物、達成条件、報酬、時系列を正確に保って説明する。

entries.EN: Find and neutralize the Mysterious Sniper. Spotted at night at the tower near the Duty base.
entries.JA_current: 夜に現れる狙撃手を始末する。奴は真夜中に姿を見せ、夜明けには消えてしまう。狙えるのは夜だけだ。給水塔のそばを探す。
entries.JA_new: 夜に現れる狙撃手を始末する。奴は真夜中に姿を見せ、夜明けには消えてしまう。狙えるのは夜だけだ。給水塔のそばを探す。

entries.EN: The group's agent should be back from the Army Warehouses soon. We need to go out to meet him, because recently it has become dangerous on the road from the warehouses.
entries.JA_current: The group's agent should be back from the Army Warehouses soon. We need to go out to meet him, because recently it has become dangerous on the road from the warehouses.
entries.JA_new: グループのエージェントは、まもなく軍事倉庫から戻るはずだ。最近、倉庫からの道は危険になっている。迎えに出よう。

entries.EN: It is necessary to find and kill a stalker named Basta. He should be in Yantar.
entries.JA_current: It is necessary to find and kill a stalker named Basta. He should be in Yantar.
entries.JA_new: バスタというストーカーを見つけて殺す。ヤンターにいるはずだ。

entries.EN: Find and deliver the "Fern Flower" to the doctor Vardock. It was seen in a small forest behind a swamp at the Garbage, the approximate location is marked on your map.
entries.JA_current: Find and deliver the "Fern Flower" to the doctor Vardock. It was seen in a small forest behind a swamp at the Garbage, the approximate location is marked on your map.
entries.JA_new: シダの花を見つけて、医師ヴァルドックに届ける。ガーベジの小さな森で目撃された。おおよその場所はマップに記してある。

entries.EN: Yuri told me about a stalker at Yantar who resembles a lost Seeker scout, called Trofim. It is necessary to investigate and confirm if this stalker is Trofim, as he may have information about the fate of the Seeker expedition.
entries.JA_current: Yuri told me about a stalker at Yantar who resembles a lost Seeker scout, called Trofim. It is necessary to investigate and confirm if this stalker is Trofim, as he may have information about the fate of the Seeker expedition.
entries.JA_new: ユーリから、ヤンターにトロフィムというストーカーがいると聞いた。行方不明になったシーカーの斥候に似ているらしい。本人かどうか確かめよう。シーカーの遠征隊の行方を知っているかもしれない。

entries.EN: Yuri: "This Raven is a suspicious type... We don't know where he went, but we need to find out if he was involved in the deaths of our guys. Here's the deal: search his hideout, it's in an old rusty KAMAZ truck parked on the outskirts of the Bar, where the road to the Army Warehouses begins."
entries.JA_current: Yuri: "This Raven is a suspicious type... We don't know where he went, but we need to find out if he was involved in the deaths of our guys. Here's the deal: search his hideout, it's in an old rusty KAMAZ truck parked on the outskirts of the Bar, where the road to the Army Warehouses begins."
entries.JA_new: ユーリ:「レイヴンは怪しい奴だ……どこへ行ったか分からないが、仲間が死んだ件に関わっていたか調べる必要がある。隠れ家を探せ。ロストクの外れ、軍事倉庫へ向かう道の始まりに停めてある、古くて錆びたKAMAZのトラックだ」

entries.EN: A laptop with encrypted data was found in Raven's cache. Yuri has advised me to go see the Barkeep, he may know someone able to decrypt the data.
entries.JA_current: A laptop with encrypted data was found in Raven's cache. Yuri has advised me to go see the Barkeep, he may know someone able to decrypt the data.
entries.JA_new: レイヴンの隠れ家で、暗号化されたデータの入ったノートPCを見つけた。ユーリはバーキープを訪ねるよう勧めてくれた。暗号を解ける奴を知っているかもしれない。

entries.EN: A laptop with encrypted data was found in Raven's cache. Yuri has advised me to go see the Barkeep, he may know someone able to decrypt the data. The barkeep, in turn, pointed to a Freedom computer whiz named Lucky, to be found at the Army warehouses.
entries.JA_current: A laptop with encrypted data was found in Raven's cache. Yuri has advised me to go see the Barkeep, he may know someone able to decrypt the data. The barkeep, in turn, pointed to a Freedom computer whiz named Lucky, to be found at the Army warehouses.
entries.JA_new: レイヴンの隠れ家で、暗号化されたデータの入ったノートPCを見つけた。ユーリはバーキープを訪ねるよう勧めてくれた。暗号を解ける奴を知っているかもしれない。バーキープは、軍事倉庫にいるフリーダムのPCに詳しい男、ラッキーを紹介してくれた。

entries.EN: The barkeep said he will grant me access to his back room, but only if I bring him the "Crystal Thorn", "Night Star" and "Flash" artifacts.
entries.JA_current: The barkeep said he will grant me access to his back room, but only if I bring him the "Crystal Thorn", "Night Star" and "Flash" artifacts.
entries.JA_new: バーキープは、バックルームに入れてやると言った。ただし、«クリスタルソーン»«ナイトスター»«フラッシュ»のアーティファクトを持ってくるのが条件だ。

entries.EN: The identity of the thief who stole a valuable artifact from the scientists is known to the Informant, but he'll only talk if he gets the "Urchin", "Crystal" and "Soul" artifacts.
entries.JA_current: The identity of the thief who stole a valuable artifact from the scientists is known to the Informant, but he'll only talk if he gets the "Urchin", "Crystal" and "Soul" artifacts.
entries.JA_new: 科学者から貴重なアーティファクトを盗んだ犯人を情報屋は知っているが、«アーチン»«クリスタル»«ソウル»のアーティファクトを渡すまで話さない。

entries.EN: General Voronin from Duty told me that some unknown individual plans to detonate explosives in crowded places at the Bar, unless people repent their sins. I have been contracted to find the terrorist and stop him. Captain Ivantsov, head of Duty guard, may have some information on this case.
entries.JA_current: General Voronin from Duty told me that some unknown individual plans to detonate explosives in crowded places at the Bar, unless people repent their sins. I have been contracted to find the terrorist and stop him. Captain Ivantsov, head of Duty guard, may have some information on this case.
entries.JA_new: デューティーのヴォロニン将軍によると、罪を悔い改めなければロストクの人混みに爆弾を仕掛けるという、正体不明の人物がいる。テロリストを見つけて阻止する仕事を請け負った。デューティー警備隊長のイヴァンツォフ大尉なら、この件について何か知っているかもしれない。

entries.EN: We need to check one of the landfill piles at the Garbage. The photo shows the place where the cache is most likely to be located.
entries.JA_current: We need to check one of the landfill piles at the Garbage. The photo shows the place where the cache is most likely to be located.
entries.JA_new: ガーベジにあるゴミ山のひとつを調べる必要がある。写真には、隠し場所がありそうな場所が写っている。

entries.EN: The old gas station in the Dark Valley has a stash hidden somewhere nearby, high up and out of sight.
entries.JA_current: The old gas station in the Dark Valley has a stash hidden somewhere nearby, high up and out of sight.
entries.JA_new: ダークバレーの古いガソリンスタンドの近く、高くて見つかりにくい場所に、隠し場所がある。

entries.EN: The Rostok Industrial Sector - a wild and dangerous place, lone stalkers rarely wander out here. However, that doesn't stop some dare-devils from trying. One of them managed to stash some valuables in the grass near a ladder.
entries.JA_current: The Rostok Industrial Sector - a wild and dangerous place, lone stalkers rarely wander out here. However, that doesn't stop some dare-devils from trying. One of them managed to stash some valuables in the grass near a ladder.
entries.JA_new: ロストク工業地帯は荒れ果てた危険な場所で、ローナーもめったに近づかない。それでも命知らずはやってくる。その一人が、はしごの近くの草むらに貴重品を隠した。

entries.EN: In the vicinity of the Yantar plant, teeming with zombies and mutants, someone managed to stash his valuables on some old construction vehicle. Well, at least his things are well guarded!
entries.JA_current: In the vicinity of the Yantar plant, teeming with zombies and mutants, someone managed to stash his valuables on some old construction vehicle. Well, at least his things are well guarded!
entries.JA_new: ゾンビとミュータントがうろつくヤンター工場の近くで、誰かが古い建設車両に貴重品を隠した。まあ、品物はしっかり守られているようだ！

entries.EN: A dead village, now occupied by new settlers of the bloodsucking variety, and I'm not talking about bandits... Who knows what's hidden in one of the houses? Stalkers rarely go in there, for this reason it's a perfect place for a stash.
entries.JA_current: A dead village, now occupied by new settlers of the bloodsucking variety, and I'm not talking about bandits... Who knows what's hidden in one of the houses? Stalkers rarely go in there, for this reason it's a perfect place for a stash.
entries.JA_new: 死んだ村には、バンディットではなくブラッドサッカーが新たに住み着いた……どの家に何が隠されているか、誰にも分からない。ストーカーはめったに近づかないから、隠し場所にはうってつけだ。

entries.EN: "All right, listen to me: go to the Garbage, to the depot. There you will find the foundation of an old rail crane, examine it carefully."
entries.JA_current: "All right, listen to me: go to the Garbage, to the depot. There you will find the foundation of an old rail crane, examine it carefully."
entries.JA_new: 「いいか、よく聞け。ガーベジの操車場へ行け。古い鉄道クレーンの基礎がある。よく調べるんだ」

entries.EN: "Not bad, stalker, since you're so good at finding rare artifacts, you'll have no issue finding my stash. It is located in the Dark Valley. There is a swamp, an island on it, and a tree on the island. Under the tree you'll find the cache."
entries.JA_current: "Not bad, stalker, since you're so good at finding rare artifacts, you'll have no issue finding my stash. It is located in the Dark Valley. There is a swamp, an island on it, and a tree on the island. Under the tree you'll find the cache."
entries.JA_new: 「いいぞ、ストーカー。珍しいアーティファクトを見つけるのが得意なら、俺の隠し場所も見つけられるはずだ。ダークバレーにある。沼地に島があって、その島に木が一本生えている。その木の下だ」

entries.EN: "Let's think, what could I give you.. Okay, I remember. So: in Yantar, on the approach to the plant, there are these old garages- "shells" I call them. Look between them, and you'll find something."
entries.JA_current: "Let's think, what could I give you.. Okay, I remember. So: in Yantar, on the approach to the plant, there are these old garages- "shells" I call them. Look between them, and you'll find something."
entries.JA_new: 「何を渡そうか……そうだ、思い出した。ヤンターの工場へ向かう途中に、古い『貝殻』みたいなガレージが並んでいる。あの間を探せば、何か見つかるはずだ」

entries.EN: "Go to the Army Warehouses, there's a bus stop next to the road. From that, follow the path to the lost village, the one that everyone avoids. Just don't go in there, I don't want your death on my conscience and the stash is not even there... Instead, keep your eyes peeled for a fallen tree near that path, then look under it."
entries.JA_current: "Go to the Army Warehouses, there's a bus stop next to the road. From that, follow the path to the lost village, the one that everyone avoids. Just don't go in there, I don't want your death on my conscience and the stash is not even there... Instead, keep your eyes peeled for a fallen tree near that path, then look under it."
entries.JA_new: 「軍事倉庫へ行け。道の脇にバス停がある。そこから、みんなが避ける迷い村へ続く小道を進め。村には入るなよ。お前の死を背負いたくないし、隠し場所も中にはない。道の近くに倒木があるから、目を凝らして、その下を探せ」

entries.EN: "You will find my last hiding place at Rostok, on the roof of one of the hangars that has a radiation hot-spot inside"
entries.JA_current: "You will find my last hiding place at Rostok, on the roof of one of the hangars that has a radiation hot-spot inside"
entries.JA_new: 「最後の隠し場所はロストクだ。中に強い放射線源がある格納庫の屋根に置いてある」

entries.EN: Caesar-11\nNYAA MCTORP
entries.JA_current: Caesar-11\nNYAA MCTORP
entries.JA_new: Caesar-11\nNYAA MCTORP
